notes.title: It's been a while since the last update!
notes.content: We've added multilingual support and introduced the paid version layout to the free version!

tags.feature: We've added multilingual support and introduced the paid version layout to the free version!

notes.title: Big update!!
notes.content:
Here's what I have implemented!

Dash
Timer setup (on the right side of the health gauge)
Automatic attacks
Boss enemies drop a forced 1up
Display of operation method in text
Main character movement animation
Enemies slow down as they get closer to the player
Persistent power-up elements
Increases in magic power (power), speed, and health
Upgrade enhancements
Increase in types (auto recovery, sacrificing speed for a significant increase in power)
Increase in attack power
Unlockable elements
Sword magic
Line magic

notes.title: Friday update!!!
notes.content:
[b]We have implemented some of the previously announced plans![/b]
Although not all of them, since it's Friday, we have made them available for you to play right away!

Visual changes to elements
Addition of boss enemies (only one...)
Addition of cards to enhance the adhesion strength of elements
We have reduced the number of enemies and made them stronger in the later stages
Bug fix for health recovery
Sound upon getting hit
Sound effect when acquiring elements
Sound effect upon leveling up
Reduced the sound effect when casting spells (previously it was loud!)

notes.title: Emergency Update
notes.content:
Emergency Update:
We have determined that there may be significant issues affecting gameplay and have made logic adjustments. Primarily, we have adjusted the screen resolution and the number of enemies.
